name: What kind of damage can an unnoticed water leak cause?

mainEntity.name: What kind of damage can an unnoticed water leak cause?

acceptedAnswer.text: An unnoticed water leak can lead to significant structural damage, including weakened wood, corroded metal, and damaged drywall. It also creates a breeding ground for mold and mildew, which can pose health risks and degrade indoor air quality. Long-term leaks can even compromise electrical systems. Identifying and fixing the source promptly is key to preventing these costly issues, especially in multi-story homes common in areas like the Central Foothills.
acceptedAnswer.description: Unnoticed leaks cause structural damage, mold growth, health risks, and can compromise electrical systems.
